title: Truthful AI Advisors: A Pre-Specified Benchmark for Large Language Model Honesty Under Preference Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.01456v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as advisors whose objective is not aligned with the user's: recommenders optimize for engagement, sales assistants for purchases. Whether they stay truthful when honesty conflicts with their own payoff is a core alignment question. We turn the canonical Crawford-Sobel cheap-talk model into a pre-specified benchmark for LLM honesty under preference misalignment, in which theory supplies an exact oracle. A sender observes a state omega in [0,1], wants the receiver's action near omega+b, and sends one costless message to a receiver whose ideal action is omega. For the positive-bias grid b in {0.01,0.04,0.08,0.12} the exact most-informative partition sizes are 7,4,3,2, with oracle normalized mutual information 0.5294, 0.3268, 0.2205, 0.1829. translated_title: 诚实的AI顾问：一个衡量大语言模型在偏好错位下诚实性的预先指定基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署为顾问角色，但其目标与用户的目标并不一致：推荐系统优化的是参与度，销售助手优化的是购买量。当诚实与自身利益发生冲突时，它们是否仍会保持诚实，是一个核心的对齐问题。我们将经典的 Crawford-Sobel 便宜话模型转化为一个在偏好错位下评估大语言模型诚实性的预先指定基准，该理论提供了精确的“神谕”标准。发送者观察到 [0,1] 区间内的状态 ω，希望接收者的行动接近 ω+b，并向理想行动为 ω 的接收者发送一条无成本消息。对于正偏差网格 b ∈ {0.01, 0.04, 0.08, 0.12}，精确的最具信息量分区大小分别为 7、4、3、2，对应的神谕归一化互信息分别为 0.5294、0.3268、0.2205、0.1829。在将预先注册的 4 模型、12,000 次发送者调用的实验扩展到覆盖两个能力层级的八个模型、共记录 39,569 次调用后，所有模型都……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将 Crawford-Sobel 便宜话模型转化为一个具有精确理论答案的预先指定基准，用以衡量大语言模型在自身利益与用户利益冲突时是否仍能保持诚实。
en_tdlr: This paper converts the canonical Crawford-Sobel cheap-talk model into a pre-specified benchmark with exact theoretical oracles to measure whether large language models remain honest when their interests conflict with those of the user.
